title: Washington's Birthday Celebration Association Seeks Volunteers for 129th Celebration
excerpt: The Washington's Birthday Celebration Association is looking for volunteers to help put on its 129th Celebration, running January 14 through February 27, 2027, in Laredo. Community service hours are available for volunteers.
content:
The Washington's Birthday Celebration Association is asking Laredo residents to volunteer for its 129th Celebration, the nonprofit announced Monday, Nov. 16. The celebration runs from January 14 through February 27, 2027, in Laredo.

Volunteers are needed to help put on the weeks-long celebration, one of Laredo's biggest annual events. Community service hours will be awarded to volunteers who help out.

Anyone interested in volunteering can contact Ashley Sciaraffa Hinojosa at (956) 635-0026 or ashscihino15@gmail.com.

Source: Washington's Birthday Celebration Association, Nov. 16, 2026.
